name: local-agent-platform
description: Shared local coding-agent platform with Mastra and LangGraph orchestrators.

scripts.bootstrap: npm install --prefix apps/unified-hub && npm install --prefix services/mastra-coding-platform && npm install --prefix services/multica-mastra-bridge && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/bootstrap-langgraph.ps1
scripts.check: npm run lint --prefix apps/unified-hub && npm run build --prefix apps/unified-hub && npm run typecheck --prefix services/mastra-coding-platform && npm run self-test --prefix services/mastra-coding-platform && npm run profile-isolation-test --prefix services/mastra-coding-platform && npm run codex-adapter-test --prefix services/mastra-coding-platform && npm run writer-lock-test --prefix services/mastra-coding-platform && npm run runtime-recovery-test --prefix services/mastra-coding-platform && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/test-langgraph.ps1 && npm test --prefix services/multica-mastra-bridge
